Debug Module Status

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x44

Source:

Description

Reports status for the Debug Module and currently selected harts. This entire register is read-only.

Field Descriptions

_reserved_31_23

Reserved.

impebreak

1: Implicit ebreak after Program Buffer. Must be 1 if abstractcs.progbufsize is 1.

_reserved_21_20

Reserved.

allhavereset

1: All currently selected harts have been reset and not acknowledged.

anyhavereset

1: At least one currently selected hart has been reset and not acknowledged.

allresumeack

1: All currently selected harts have acknowledged their last resume request.

anyresumeack

1: Any currently selected hart has acknowledged its last resume request.

allnonexistent

1: All currently selected harts do not exist in this platform.

anynonexistent

1: Any currently selected hart does not exist in this platform.

allunavail

1: All currently selected harts are unavailable.

anyunavail

1: Any currently selected hart is unavailable.

allrunning

1: All currently selected harts are running.

anyrunning

1: Any currently selected hart is running.

allhalted

1: All currently selected harts are halted.

anyhalted

1: Any currently selected hart is halted.

authenticated

0: Authentication required. 1: Authentication passed. Preset to 1 if no authentication implemented.

authbusy

0: Authentication module ready. 1: Authentication module busy.

hasresethaltreq

1: DM supports halt-on-reset functionality (setresethaltreq/clrresethaltreq bits in dmcontrol).

confstrptrvalid

0: confstrptr0-3 are not relevant to config string. 1: confstrptr0-3 hold config string address.

version

Debug Module version. 0=No DM, 1=v0.11, 2=v0.13, 15=Non-conformant.
